entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. I feel awful about it, but I just don't think I can keep it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-9240. It's for the Aero Road Helmet. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I've never returned anything before.

Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet, delivered about two and a half months ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, no, it's not a fault. It's just... the color. On the website, it looked like a deep crimson, but in person, it's much brighter. It just doesn't match my bike at all. I know it sounds silly, but I was so excited. The box is unopened, I haven't even tried it on.

That's not silly at all; we want you to be completely happy with your gear. It's important to feel good in what you're wearing, especially when it comes to safety equipment. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you.
Okay. I was just really hoping to get that money back before the holidays. It would help a lot.
I understand completely. And I have good news. Looking at our policy, this helmet is well within the 90-day return window. You are absolutely eligible for a full refund.
Oh, really? You're sure? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course. It's my pleasure to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. Thank you again. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
